# rixl_organization_member (Resource)

Manages member assignment and role in a Rixl organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_organization_member" "admin" {
  org_id  = var.rixl_org_id
  user_id = "usr_01h7abc456"
  role    = "ORGANIZATION_ROLE_ADMIN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)
- `role` (String)
- `user_id` (String)

### Optional

- `state` (String)

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invitation_expires_at` (String)
- `joined_at` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `username` (String)
